name: BAND
summary: Six players on one board: drums you knock or draw on a grid, bass, lead, keys, ocarina and tuned feedback, in one key and tempo. Syncs with a SING.
author: willbearfruits
status_note: Runs on a board: about 45 % CPU idle, 55 % with drums, bass, keys and lead playing, no dropouts (2026-10-15). Not played much yet.
